snippet.title: Portal: Divinity - Chapter 1 Trailer
snippet.description:
"You are awoken as a maintenance employee, told by a mysterious voice on the phone that you have been deployed in the wing of Aperture known as Eastern-7 to repair the damaged complex. Navigate through lush foliage and harsh tundras to repair various parts of the facility, while learning that there may be more to this facility's downfall than you originally thought."

Our MODDB page:
https://www.moddb.com/mods/portal-divinity

Our Discord:
https://discord.gg/uYzuqg2j3g

Portal Mapping and Modding Discord:
https://discord.gg/pmam

The maps in this trailer were decorated by Qquash, Nuclear Shill, Triplix, and Prxwkey. The puzzles of this mod were designed by ComandrTNT, masalt, and Dark Rozen. The music of this mod was composed by Kris (PRYZM), masalt, and Frosti. Voice acting of the "Telephone" character by TheRedInkling.
